blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–NLEX’s Robert Bolick became the early frontrunner in the race for the Best Player of the Conference in the PBA Governors’ Cup. Bolick had 37.1 Statistical Points through the end of the group stage based on the official tally released by the PBA on Monday to take the lead over Terrafirma’s Maverick Ahanmisi and Converge’s Justin Arana, Justine Baltazar and Juan Gomez de Liano. READ: PBA: Robert Bolick keeps NLEX’s impressive run in perspective Ahanmisi is second with 35.7 SPs, with Arana in third with 34.7 while Baltazar (34.2) and Gomez de Liano (33.8) round out the top five.
